details:
This update for openssh fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-59995: sftp: a malicious server could change the the location of downloaded files (bsc#1271044).
- CVE-2026-59996: scp: a malicious server could write files to the parent directory of the intended target directory
  (bsc#1271046).
- CVE-2026-59997: sshd: internal-sftp command lines are silently truncated after the 9th argument (bsc#1271048).
- CVE-2026-59998: sshd: Undocumented GSSAPIStrictAcceptorCheck behavior impacts security in Windows Active Directory
  (bsc#1271049).
- CVE-2026-59999: sshd: DisableForwarding=yes didn't override PermitTunnel=yes (bsc#1271052).
- CVE-2026-60000: sshd: pre-authentication denial of service when GSSAPIAuthentication is enabled (bsc#1271053).
- CVE-2026-60001: sshd: honor the minimum authentication delay (bsc#1271054).
- CVE-2026-60002: ssh: client-side use-after-free when a server changes its host key during a key reexchange
  (bsc#1271055).
- CVE-2026-73281: refused binding requests on locked SSH agents can allow destination restriction bypasses
  (bsc#1275075).
- CVE-2026-73282: unsynchronized remote forwarding updates in SSH client multiplexing can cause use-after-free
  (bsc#1275074).
- CVE-2026-73283: unenforced restriction keywords on tunnel forwarding can allow administrative security policy bypasses
  (bsc#1275079).
